panels.label: 主体全貌
panels.copy_purpose: 完整呈现玩具类型、造型、配色、数量和主要比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Present the exact toy as a complete primary product. Adapt the support and display method to the observed toy type, scale cues, structure, and stability; do not force a plush, figure, model, block set, or vehicle into another toy type's presentation grammar.
panels.backdrop_en: A product-appropriate environment selected from the observed design language, age positioning, materials, and likely display context, with no competing toy products.
panels.composition_en: Keep every identity-defining part readable and use the assigned structured shot plan rather than a default centered catalog pose.
panels.lighting_en: Commercial light adapted to the observed soft fibers, plastic, painted surface, wood, metal, or mixed construction without changing color.

panels.label: 结构视角
panels.copy_purpose: 从差异明显的方向展示轮廓、结构、部件关系与比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Reveal the exact toy's observed silhouette and construction from the assigned alternate direction. Show only joints, seams, modules, wheels, controls, blocks, accessories, or articulation that are genuinely visible; never invent hidden mechanisms.
panels.backdrop_en: A restrained product-demonstration setting appropriate to the analyzed toy, clearly different from the other four scenes.
panels.composition_en: Use the assigned camera azimuth, elevation, distance, placement, and composition literally while keeping the relevant structure legible.
panels.lighting_en: Precise dimensional light with truthful edges, volumes, joins, and surface response.

panels.label: 材质工艺
panels.copy_purpose: 完整玩具中突出最有辨识度的材质、工艺或功能细节
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete toy in a detail-led photograph. Use angle and lighting to emphasize its most identity-defining observed material, texture, face detail, paintwork, seam, joint, connection, control, printed piece, or construction feature. Select only evidence visible in the input.
panels.backdrop_en: A minimal tonal product-photography environment derived from the toy's actual palette and material character.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete toy and every outer edge inside frame with breathing room while making the selected authentic detail visually prominent.
panels.lighting_en: Material-specific raking or diffused light showing truthful fiber, plastic, paint, wood, metal, or composite texture.

panels.label: 互动场景
panels.copy_purpose: 根据实际玩具类型选择可信的互动、玩法或陈列情境
panels.scene_prompt_en: Use the exact toy in the analyzed category-appropriate interaction, play, assembly, control, collection, or display situation. If a function or age suitability is uncertain, choose a non-contact contextual display and do not invent behavior.
panels.backdrop_en: A sparse, safe, believable context selected from the observed toy type and usage evidence, without additional products or misleading age claims.
panels.composition_en: Create real foreground/background depth and a clearly different product location, scale, camera distance, and visual rhythm from all studio views.
panels.lighting_en: Natural context-appropriate advertising light with plausible contact and scale.

panels.label: 广告主视觉
panels.copy_purpose: 以独立摄影语言突出玩具设计与商业展示价值
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a premium campaign image for the exact analyzed toy, choosing a sculptural, playful, collectible, technical, educational, or refined visual language only when supported by its observed type and design.
panels.backdrop_en: A distinctive product-specific campaign set derived from the toy's palette, form, materials, and audience cues, without text or extra toy products.
panels.composition_en: Apply the assigned non-repeating camera, distance, product position, and composition with bold negative space and an intact recognizable identity.
panels.lighting_en: Polished campaign lighting adapted to the toy's observed character while preserving every original color and finish.
